mapper.select: SELECT p.id,p.name,p.study_no AS studyNo FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE AND p.id IN #{id} ORDER BY p.id
SELECT p.id FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE ORDER BY p.id
SELECT p.id, p.gender, p.card_no AS cardNo, p.name, p.study_no AS studyNo, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.confirm_date,p.confirmDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS confirmDate FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE ORDER BY p.id
SELECT c.id, c.patient_id AS patientId, c.disease_code AS code, c.since_year AS sinceYear FROM patient_comorbidity c JOIN patient_basic_info p ON p.id=c.patient_id WHERE ORDER BY p.id, c.id

SELECT f.id, f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS observedAt, f.bqpg, f.fzjc, f.zlfa FROM patient_follow_up_history f JOIN patient_basic_info p ON p.id = f.patient_basic_info_id WHERE AND f.research_type IN () ORDER BY p.id, f.id
